page.title: Portal submissions
page.subtitle: Get invoice packets into your customers' AP channels and track them to payment. A person approves every send.
page.offline: You are offline. Nothing new will appear until the connection returns.

forbidden.title: Billing access required
forbidden.body: Portal submissions involve invoices and customer credentials. Ask the account owner for billing access.

disabled.title: Portal submission is switched off
disabled.body: Nothing is sent until the account owner turns it on in Settings. Existing records stay visible.

console.empty: No submissions yet. Start one from an invoice once a portal is set up.

assisted.title: Copy-ready values
assisted.intro: Open the customer's portal, copy each value in, then record the confirmation below.
assisted.noLink: No safe portal link is saved for this profile.
assisted.missing: Missing — fix the invoice or the portal profile first
assisted.evidence: Or upload a screenshot or PDF of the confirmation

status.label: What does the portal show now?
status.reason: Reason given by the portal (required when rejected)

profiles.empty: No portals yet. Add the first one for a customer.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.config: Field mapping, checklist and status vocabulary (JSON)
profiles.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect revokes consent, turns automation off and permanently deletes stored credentials for this portal.

vault.title: Credentials
vault.writeOnly: Stored credentials are never shown. You can replace them, not read them.
vault.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can store credentials.

remit.upload: Upload remittance advice (text, CSV, PDF or image)
remit.uploaded: Uploaded. Review the matches before anything is applied.
remit.manual: Vireek could not read this file automatically. It is in the review queue; nothing was applied.
remit.reviewNote: Only exact matches are applied. Mismatches stay here until you resolve them.

settings.title: Safety switches
settings.intro: Everything is off by default. Turn on only the channels you have set up.
settings.kill: Automation kill switch (stops all automation for this account)
settings.approval: A person approves every automated submit (always on in this screen)
settings.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can change these switches.
settings.automationNote: Automation also needs a platform-level switch, per-portal consent and a worker that your administrator deploys.

consent.title: Before you allow automation
consent.body: Automation signs in to your customer's portal with credentials you provide and acts on your behalf. You confirm that you are authorised to use these credentials this way, and that the portal's terms do not forbid it. Vireek never bypasses CAPTCHA or multi-factor prompts; it stops and asks you. Every run is logged.
consent.check: I confirm I am authorised and have read the portal's terms.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
errors.not_allowed: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.feature_disabled: Portal submission is switched off for this account.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment.
errors.packet_must_be_pdf: The packet must be a PDF file.
errors.ap_email_invalid: The AP mailbox on this portal profile is not a valid address.
errors.invoice_number_required: The invoice needs a number before it can be submitted.
errors.owner_only: Only the account owner can do that.
errors.unknown_status: Vireek does not recognise that status. Add it to this portal's status mapping.
errors.reference_or_evidence_required: Enter a reference number or upload evidence.
errors.evidence_type_not_allowed: Use a PNG, JPEG or PDF.
errors.invalid_input: Check the fields and try again.
errors.duplicate: This invoice already has a live submission to this portal. Showing it instead.
